name: Trans Sumatra
definition: Toll backbone built by Hutama Karya (JTTS), Lampung to Aceh
notes: About 1,161 km built, of which 982 km operational. Bina Marga reports 1,051.84 km Phase I operational (Aug 2026); the figures differ by scope and date.
source_title: Hutama Karya buka-bukaan soal JTTS di hadapan BAKN DPR RI

name: Trans Papua
definition: National road corridor from Sorong to Merauke
notes: 3,446 km connected; 2,235 km paved and 1,132 km still soil as of November 2025. About 50 km remains on Jayapura-Wamena (December 2025).
source_title: TNI targetkan proyek Trans Papua rampung di era Prabowo

name: Trans Sulawesi
definition: National road corridor; a separate 1,300+ km toll plan exists
notes: No single official km series found. Road and toll plans use different scopes; needs segment-level data before publishing a progress bar.

name: Trans Kalimantan
notes: Definitions conflict: 1,186 km travel route, 1,920 km border-parallel road and 2,100.8 km WPS figure are different things. Needs segment-level data.
